mapper.select: select i.plan_item_id, i.visitor_id, i.app_user_id, i.program_id, i.source, i.source_ref, i.tier_snapshot, i.sort_order, s.school_name, p.program_name, s.country, i.create_time, i.update_time, (p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0') as active from abr_plan_item i join abr_program p on p.program_id = i.program_id join abr_school s on s.school_id = p.school_id where i.visitor_id = #{visitorId} order by i.sort_order, i.plan_item_id
select count(*) from abr_plan_item where visitor_id = #{visitorId}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_plan_item (visitor_id, app_user_id, program_id, source, source_ref, tier_snapshot, sort_order, create_time, update_time) values (#{visitorId}, #{appUserId}, #{programId}, #{source}, #{sourceRef}, #{tierSnapshot}, coalesce(#{sortOrder}, 0), now(), now()) on conflict (visitor_id, program_id) do update set source = excluded.source, source_ref = excluded.source_ref, tier_snapshot = excluded.tier_snapshot, update_time = now()
mapper.delete: delete from abr_plan_item where visitor_id = #{visitorId} and program_id = #{programId}
